versions.changelog:
Initial release of image-edit-runcomfy — advanced image editing powered by RunComfy CLI.

- Supports various image editing tasks: background swap, object removal/addition, text rewriting, and mask-driven region replacement.
- Handles single-image, batch (up to 20), multi-reference, and mask-based edits up to 4K resolution.
- Automatically routes requests to the appropriate model based on user intent for optimal results.
- Integrates with RunComfy CLI; requires RunComfy account and setup.
- Triggered by explicit image edit prompts such as “edit image,” “remove object,” “swap background,” etc.
